_comment: MG-04 parity allow-list. Paths a Muster-vs-Planner comparison may ignore, each with a reason and the decision that permits it. The Planner golden check (golden:check) does NOT use this file: Planner goldens must match byte for byte. The Muster-side comparator (MG-04, Muster PR) reads it. Every entry needs a BHD decision reference; do not add entries without one.

entries.reason: Pricing is out of scope for Muster (BHD decision D1). Muster omits the block; Planner still generates it.
Generation timestamp; goldens use the fixture clock, Muster uses run time.
